## Use

Read [shared theme guidance](../GUIDANCE.md) before using this reference.
Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Brand

Dramatic design style is a trend characterized by high-contrast visuals, bold,
unconventional layouts, and immersive, theatrical experiences designed to grab
user attention.

## Style foundations

- Visual style: modern, clean, high-contrast
- Typography scale: 12/14/16/20/24/32 | Fonts: primary=Outfit, display=Outfit,
  mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=400, 900
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#8B5CF6, secondary=#F43F5E, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#09090B, text=#FAFAFA
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

High-contrast, theatrical design with bold layouts, immersive visuals, and
unconventional compositions that command attention.
